messages.subject_clean: Don't allow shiny to advance action button unless response chosen
messages.body_plain:
Often when we build a shiny app we have some input but don't want to evaluate that input until an action button is clicked.  After the action button is clicked it does something based on the original input.

I'm in that situation now where I've made an app that iterates through items in a vector of question items as well as a vector of response items via a dynamicUI similar to the app seen in this survey example: https://github.com/EconometricsBySimulation/Shiny-Demos/tree/master/Survey.

I iterate through the possible responses as a radioButtons setting selected=character(0) to force the user to select a choice.  I have a next button that then sends this info to a database and afterward resets the radioButtons.  The problem is that if the user clicks the next button before selecting a radio button choice then character(0) is sent to the database.  I want the next button to advance only if the radio button state isn't character(0).

How can I accomplish the stuff that the next button triggers to not happen of the output from the radioButtons are character(0).  Again these radioButtons are reset after each click and appear this way in the UI but if I render the text from the input$radioButtion I can see it is not NULL or character(0) but what ever the previous clicked state was.  My setup is very similar to the link I posted in that the items and possible responses are being iterated through and served up as a dynamicUI.

It continues to work fine in Safari. Any thoughts on why this could be? My early guess is that Chrome is shutting down because it's asked to load what it considers to be too much data from the server, but I don't know if that's indeed the case.

And, fwiw, I've tried to use chrome's developer console to find something informative, but the page freezes before any insightful info can be displayed that way.

Thanks in advance!

-Lucas
